exposure: FS MRg-LITT (non-robotized frameless stereotactic Magnetic Resonance guided Laser Interstitial Thermal Therapy)
cohort: Two pediatric patients with hypothalamic hamartoma (HH) related gelastic seizures treated with FS MRg-LITT.
finding: FS MRg-LITT for the treatment of HH-related epilepsy was effective, resulting in both patients being seizure-free with preserved endocrinological functions at 1-year follow-up, and demonstrating adequate accuracy with no perioperative complications.
